audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and several bullets now name High Note (8-6s), Surround Sound (22s), and Encore (160-120s) alongside Beat Drop.

edits.before: - Seraphine Beat Drop (Root): matchup-defining — Roots anyone already slowed — dodge it and the song never builds to the charm. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Beat Drop (E) is 11-9s and roots anyone already slowed by High Note (Q, 8-6s CD) — dodge the root and the song never chains to Encore (R). - Surround Sound (W) is 22s; its shield-then-heal makes anti-heal worth buying early. - Encore (R, 160-120s) is easy to Spell Shield if you time E on the cast.
